name: hint.list
title: List hints
summary: Open hints of the workspace, filterable by kind, type, package or variant.

kind.description: Only hints with one of these codes.

type.description: Only hints about elements of one of these types, or of a type that extends one of them (SR-012).

package.description: Only hints about elements whose property with the meaning packages lists this package.

variant.description: Only hints about elements in the view of this variant (SR-043); a hint about a variant element only for that variant.

ref.description: Only the hints about this element.

hints.description: The open hints: findings of severity warning about one element (glossary "Hinweis": the element should be checked; it blocks nothing and changes no status), from the same whole-workspace findings as workspace.check; errors, info and warnings about no element are not hints. Filters combine with AND. Each hint with its kind (code), the element it is about (elementId, repository, file, line), its target where it has one (targetId; with targetRepository, targetShortId and targetIdentifier when it was resolved to one element, #172) and its reason (message; for an outdated relation with both versions and their dates, D-013). In the order of workspace.check.

incomplete.description: True while a repository of the workspace file is not on this machine: the hints of its elements are not listed (SR-006 AK2).
